summary: Firefox’s font system now relies more consistently on Skrifa for font metrics, glyph codes, variation data, names, and tables across FreeType, Core Text, fontconfig, and downloaded webfonts. It adds CSS support for Fangsong and Kai fonts, improves character-map sharing and thread safety, and makes font loading and shutdown more reliable. The same work also strengthens hardware video encoding and decoding checks, including DRM configuration changes and disabling hardware decoding on Linux when dmabuf support is unavailable.
